Writing Functions
================

## Functions!

Start small w Z scores

``` r
x_vec = rnorm(n=40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec))/sd(x_vec)
```

    ##  [1] -2.3852687350 -0.2024612186 -0.0002902468  0.3254745297  1.0183035054
    ##  [6]  0.9474682235  0.1583526913 -0.0774765430 -1.8170557585  0.3335621449
    ## [11] -0.5505563373 -1.4992582489  2.4409691291  0.7662976636  0.1293856726

    ## [26]  0.5952566109  0.0568287507 -1.8384728049 -0.2606582759 -1.5054532212
    ## [31]  1.4466476847 -0.4095110388 -0.8483000339 -0.7104326537 -1.5689016537
    ## [36]  0.5107900181  0.0949778826  0.4095987180  0.5571241512 -0.7749267502

Let’s turn this into a function

``` r
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if(!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x))/sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}
```

Does this actually work??

``` r
z_scores(x_vec)
```
